changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.2 test build fixes Standard TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning on Jellyfin Android phone/tablet and Android TV. Android Record requests now return before player handoff, then a hosted dispatcher targets only the active media-control controller, avoiding Web Player spinner stalls and Android session/controller misrouting. Standard TV HLS compatibility, scheduling and Personalized TV behavior are unchanged.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.
